* * * * * * @usage * ```astro nocollapse * --- * import { Resizable, ResizablePanel, ResizableHandle } from '@bejamas/ui/components/resizable'; * --- * * One * * Two * * ``` * * @api * * ### Panel Constraints * * Sizes are percentages of the group. Set them on each `ResizablePanel`: * * | Prop | Type | Default | Description | * |------|------|---------|-------------| * | `defaultSize` | `number` | even split | Initial size | * | `minSize` | `number` | `0` | Minimum size | * | `maxSize` | `number` | `100` | Maximum size | * | `collapsible` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether the panel can collapse below `minSize` | * | `collapsedSize` | `number` | `0` | Size when collapsed; must not exceed `minSize` | * * ### Events * * The group emits custom events on its root element: * * | Event | Detail | Description | * |-------|--------|-------------| * | `resizable:change` | `{ layout: number[] }` | Fired when the panel sizes change | * * ```js nocollapse * const group = document.getElementById('my-resizable'); * * group.addEventListener('resizable:change', (event) => { * console.log('Layout:', event.detail.layout); * }); * ``` * * ### Programmatic Control * * Dispatch `resizable:set` on the root with one size per panel. Values are normalized to 100% and clamped to each panel's constraints: * * ```js nocollapse * const group = document.getElementById('my-resizable'); * * group.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('resizable:set', { * detail: { layout: [30, 70] } * })); * ``` * * ### Keyboard * * | Key | Action | * |-----|--------| * | `ArrowLeft` / `ArrowRight` | Resize a horizontal group by `keyboardResizeBy` percent | * | `ArrowUp` / `ArrowDown` | Resize a vertical group by `keyboardResizeBy` percent | * | `Shift` + arrow | Move to the limit in that direction | * | `Home` / `End` | Minimize / maximize the preceding panel | * | `Enter` | Toggle the preceding panel when it is collapsible | * | `F6` / `Shift` + `F6` | Focus the next / previous handle in the group | * * ### Data Attributes * * | Attribute | Element | Description | * |-----------|---------|-------------| * | `data-direction` | group, panel, handle | Layout axis (`horizontal` or `vertical`) | * | `data-state` | panel | `expanded` or `collapsed` | * | `data-collapsed`, `data-expanded` | panel | Present for the matching state | * | `data-active` | handle | `pointer` while dragging, `keyboard` while focused | * * @examples * ### Vertical * * * *
